arStrings.szText: {icon:bullet,1.2} Dealing direct damage to enemies {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} times grants {c_important}Prowess{/c} for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"]{/c} seconds, stacking up to {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 2"]{/c} times, but does not refresh at {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 2"]{/c} stacks. Jaguar Skills gain {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 3"|%+|]{/c} Cast Speed and {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 4"|%x|]{/c} Critical Strike Damage per stack.
